title: Punctuation essentials
examples: When do I use a comma?
What is the difference between a full stop and a comma?
Can I use question marks in statements?

explain.say: A full stop ends a simple statement. You use it when you are telling someone something.

items: A full stop ends a statement.
It signals the end of a thought.

explain.say: A question mark ends a direct question. You use it when you want an answer.

items: A question mark ends a question.
It shows you are asking something.

explain.say: Commas separate items in a list. You use them when you have three or more things together.

draw.text: Commas separate items in a list.

explain.say: Look at this sentence. It is a statement so it needs a full stop at the end.

draw.text: I like blue green and yellow

explain.say: This sentence asks something so it needs a question mark. You are asking for information.

draw.text: Are you coming to the party

explain.say: We use commas when listing things. We put a comma after each item except the last one.

draw.text: I saw dogs cats and birds

faq.q: When should I use a comma in a list?
faq.a: You use commas to separate three or more words or items in a series. For example, I bought bread, milk, and eggs.
asks: Where do commas go in a list?
Do I need commas when listing things?

faq.q: What is the difference between a full stop and a comma?
faq.a: A full stop ends a complete thought, making a sentence finished. A comma shows a short pause within a sentence.
asks: Can I use a comma instead of a full stop?
When is a comma used instead of a full stop?

faq.q: Do I always use a question mark at the end of a question?
faq.a: Yes, a question mark is the main punctuation for direct questions. It shows that you expect an answer.
asks: What punctuation goes at the end of a question?
Should I put a question mark here?

faq.q: Can I use a question mark in a statement?
faq.a: No, you should not use a question mark in a statement. Statements always end with a full stop.
asks: Is a question mark okay for telling facts?
When is a statement a question?

faq.q: What if my list has only two items?
faq.a: If your list only has two items, you usually only need a comma before the 'and'. For example, apples and bananas.
asks: Do I need a comma for two things?
How many commas for two items?

facts: A full stop marks the end of a declarative sentence.
A question mark is used for interrogative sentences.
Commas separate items in a series of three or more.
A sentence must start with a capital letter.

quiz.say: The cat sat on the mat it was very sleepy
quiz.show: The cat sat on the mat. It was very sleepy.

options.show: The cat sat on the mat, it was very sleepy.
options.say: The cat sat on the mat, it was very sleepy.

options.show: The cat sat on the mat; it was very sleepy.
options.say: The cat sat on the mat; it was very sleepy.

options.show: The cat sat on the mat: it was very sleepy.
options.say: The cat sat on the mat: it was very sleepy.

options.show: The cat sat on the mat. It was very sleepy.
options.say: The cat sat on the mat. It was very sleepy.

quiz.why: You need a full stop after 'mat' because it ends the first complete thought.

wrong.0: A comma here is too weak; it connects two separate sentences.
wrong.1: A semicolon is too strong; a full stop is best here.
wrong.2: A colon suggests a list or explanation, which is not needed here.

quiz.say: What punctuation ends this sentence? Where is the library located
quiz.why: Because this sentence asks a direct question, it must end with a question mark.

wrong.0: A full stop turns your question into a simple statement.
wrong.1: Leaving no punctuation makes the sentence unclear to read.
wrong.2: A colon is used to introduce a list, not to end a question.

quiz.say: Which sentence correctly uses commas in a list?
quiz.show: I need pencils erasers and rulers

options.show: I need pencils, erasers, and rulers.
options.say: I need pencils, erasers, and rulers.

options.show: I need pencils, erasers and rulers.
options.say: I need pencils, erasers and rulers.

options.show: I need pencils erasers, and rulers.
options.say: I need pencils erasers, and rulers.

options.show: I need pencils; erasers; and rulers.
options.say: I need pencils; erasers; and rulers.

quiz.why: You must use commas to separate each item in the list, including the one before 'and'.

wrong.1: You missed the comma before the final item.
wrong.2: You should not put a comma after 'erasers' if you are using the Oxford comma.
wrong.3: A semicolon is too strong for separating simple list items.
